posts.title: AGI means whatever we want it to mean
posts.description: OpenAI shipped a new model; Greg Brockman shipped an attitude.

posts.title: Who Belongs in the Denominator?
posts.description: The 82% miscarriage figure circulating in the Senate is built from real numbers and valid arithmetic. It's what happens when you stop working the problem halfway through.

posts.title: God Is Dead. Long Live The Algorithm.
posts.description: Pope Leo XIV warns about concentrated, unaccountable power. He should know. The Church spent centuries wielding it. Now the capital has moved to Silicon Valley, and the new gods are just getting started.
